claim: Three API/hosted models are overconfident on security correctness of generated code; verbalized-confidence ECE is 0.456-0.481 (GPT-4o-mini), 0.408-0.421 (Qwen3-Coder-Next), 0.247-0.263 (Gemini-2.0-Flash) across six temperatures.
quoted_support: ECE ∈ [0.456,0.481] and [0.408,0.421], respectively), while Gemini-2.0-Flash shows comparatively better calibration (ECE ∈ [0.247,0.263])
candidate_component_bearing: F? no. L1 (execution-graded calibration on code, partially), L3 (calibrated-threshold repair loop, partial), L4 (repair). Does NOT make L2 core claim (no probes). Core claim on code with execution labels: yes for verbalized/token/sampling calibration of security and functional correctness (Docker tests), PARTIAL for L3/L4.
